T20_LC_P10.verdict: STOPPED under DEAD_LEVER_AUDIT.md section 24.4 condition (a). NOT TRANSCRIBED. This case does not get a best guess.
T20_LC_P10.what_the_prose_does_pin: The value IS pinned and IS citable: S7.2 :793-794 -- 'Planted (T20_LC_P10): identical case with fvOptions explicit source 5500 (= 5000 x 1.10) and nothing else changed.' So the STOP is NOT because the number is unsourced.
T20_LC_P10.why_it_stops_anyway: THE BUILDER CANNOT HONOUR IT, AND TRANSCRIBING IT WOULD CREATE A DEAD LEVER. build_t20.py:146 writes the fvOptions source from the GLOBAL block, `ph['q_volumetric']`, and never consults a per-case value; the case schema (T20_LC_c) carries NO per-case physics field at all. A `q_volumetric` key added to the P10 case entry would therefore be INERT: the builder would emit 5000, and the tree would be byte-identical to T20_LC_f while the registration claimed it was the +10 percent planted arm. That is a registered lever connected to nothing -- the exact failure class this audit file is named for -- and it is worse than an absent case because it would silently pass a planted control that never actually planted anything.
T20_LC_P10.what_would_be_needed: A per-case physics override honoured by the builder. That is a SECOND builder change; T20's one in-flight instrument pass under the 2026-08-31 plumbing freeze is spent on constant/g (build_t20b.py). NOT proposed here and NOT requested -- recorded only, so the next reader knows why six became five.
T20_LC_P10.consequence_disclosed: Q3's planted arm (S12 verdict map V5, :1062) cannot run without P10, and V5's refusal makes the whole rung NOT A RESULT. So T20 CANNOT REACH A FULL GRADED RESULT on the five cases transcribed here. That limit is stated up front rather than discovered at grading.
